description:
Dark Angel's Inner Circle Task Force and Interrogation Conclave take on the pure aggression of World Eater's Goretrack Onslaught and Vessel's of Wrath. This 40k in 40m brought to you by Snot Goblin Gaming and FutureProof Modular Terrain ready for any edition https://futureproofterrain.com/

Lists below! Jordan has cooked up something fierce with his World Eaters! He won a Golden Ticket with Goretrack Onslaught and has added Vessel's of Wrath for some aggressive spice. Tak just got back from the Warhammer event in Dallas and plays a list constructed by the Tzeentch'ing masterminds, Aiden and Mubin, that combines Inner Circle Task Force and Interrogation Conclave. The players are both playing Priority Assets thus they play the same mission: Sabotage.
